changelog: TIER A3 #A3-8 closure (fire-17 P4-META-E2, Claude opus 4.7 fallback). 'Hidden +4.31σ monopole-preserving dipole' in App E (§sec:app_morphology HC-cut robustness paragraph) disambiguated. The +4.31σ estimator is now explicitly defined in a new footnote as the single-mode pseudo-Cℓ^(ℓ=1) on the canonical mask BEFORE mean-pixel subtraction AND BEFORE MASTER deconvolution (same per-pixel random-label permutation null as canonical +3.64σ, N_MC=500, seed 42). Paragraph re-written to acknowledge: (a) +4.31σ vs +0.43σ are different estimators not directly comparable; (b) ~10× gap sourced by monopole-mask leakage already quantified in §sec:monopole_mask_null; (c) substantive HC-cut finding is the cut-dependence (~7× collapse) WITHIN this estimator, NOT consistency with the real-space dipole; (d) headline nulls (+0.43σ real-space + −0.122σ MASTER subsample) unaffected.
